title: Professional first impression
outcomeGuarantees: A chart created with data only, in ten lines or fewer, looks finished: titled axes with units, readable ticks, a legend when there is more than one series.
The first render is not animated and shows the data at once; empty, loading and error states show a message inside the plot.
Numbers and dates read in the page locale without configuration.

manualAt.protocolNote: First impression is judged visually and by the automated name/axe checks; reader experience is owned by screen-reader.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.

title: Legible reading
outcomeGuarantees: No visible text overlaps other text or is clipped, and no label disappears without being announced.
Text is at least 12 CSS px with at least 4.5:1 contrast against what is behind it.
Scales are meaningful: bar, area and histogram value axes include zero, ticks fall on round values, temporal values are never mixed silently.

manualAt.protocolNote: Legibility is measured geometrically and by contrast in the browser suite; no assistive technology is involved.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.

title: Precise hover readouts
outcomeGuarantees: Pointing anywhere in the plot shows what is there by the type's picking rule; the readout matches the drawn frame exactly.
Tooltip content lists every visible series at that position (stack totals on area, percentages on donut, the full interval on histogram).
The readout is stable: it does not flicker or jump while the pointer is still.

manualAt.protocolNote: Pointer readouts are visual; their non-pointer equivalent is covered by keyboard and screen-reader.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.

title: Natural exploration
outcomeGuarantees: Zoom on time, date and numeric x is reachable by buttons, keyboard, wheel/pinch and two-click range selection, and Reset always returns to the full view.
The zoomed value axis stays inside the visible data; nothing is drawn outside the plot.
Every interaction works with a single pointer without dragging.

manualAt.protocolNote: Zoom and range selection announcements have not been checked with a real screen reader.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.
Range-selection and zoom announcements are verified only through automated ARIA checks, not with real assistive technology.

title: Series comparison
outcomeGuarantees: Each series is identifiable without colour: dash, marker shape or direct label in addition to its swatch.
Up to eight series never share a colour; beyond eight a diagnostic is raised.
Stacked and grouped comparisons keep positive and negative values on their own sides of zero, and legend toggles show and hide series predictably.

manualAt.protocolNote: Not-colour-alone is checked by rendering; no assistive technology is involved.

title: Responsive resizing
outcomeGuarantees: The chart follows its container in both directions with no call from the page.
At any width labels adapt instead of clipping or overflowing; content reflows at 320 CSS px and 400% zoom without two-dimensional scrolling.
When the figure cannot hold a readable plot it says so instead of drawing an unreadable one.

manualAt.protocolNote: Reflow is measured in the browser suite.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.
No test resizes a histogram across widths; histogram resize behaviour is inferred from the shared layout tests.

title: Mobile and touch
outcomeGuarantees: On phone-width viewports the chart stays readable and every interaction is reachable with a single touch, without dragging.
Readouts on narrow viewports move to the strip instead of covering the data.

manualAt.protocolNote: Touch is emulated in desktop Chrome; no real phone or mobile screen reader has been used.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.
Touch and narrow-viewport behaviour is verified only in emulated desktop Chrome, never on a real phone.

title: Keyboard navigation
outcomeGuarantees: At most two tab stops while the table is closed; arrow keys move through data in the documented order for each type.
Focus survives updates, appends and zoom, and there is never a keyboard trap.
Moving focus to a point conveys its text through the accessibility tree.

manualAt.protocolNote: A3 requires a real screen reader announcing focused points; automated tests read the ARIA/AX tree only.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.
A3 (focused point conveyed through assistive technology) has not been verified with NVDA, JAWS or VoiceOver.

title: Screen-reader exploration
outcomeGuarantees: Every chart has an accessible name and a summary that states what the chart shows, including any values left out.
"View as table" opens an HTML table of the normalized data that a screen-reader user can explore.
Data arriving does not speak; announcements happen only for the reader's own actions.
axe-core reports no violations in any state.

manualAt.protocolNote: Automated checks cover names, roles, the AX tree and axe-core; reading order and announcements with a real screen reader are not verified.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.
No manual pass with NVDA, JAWS or VoiceOver has been recorded for the summary, table or live-region behaviour.

title: Transparent invalid-data handling
outcomeGuarantees: Input that cannot be plotted as given is reported with a stable AX1xx code naming the field and row, never guessed.
Missing values are never drawn as zero or bridged unless asked; the chart tells the reader when values were left out.
In strict mode a rejected update or append leaves the chart exactly as it was.

manualAt.protocolNote: Diagnostics are developer-facing; the reader-facing note is covered by screen-reader.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.

title: Theming and customization
outcomeGuarantees: Colors, font and spacing follow documented CSS custom properties and inherit from the page.
Light, dark and forced-colors modes stay legible without extra configuration.
Every built-in string can be replaced through messages, and colors overrides are honoured.

manualAt.protocolNote: Theming and forced-colors are visual and OS display modes rather than assistive technology; native Windows contrast verification is tracked as an owned gap.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.
No theme or forced-colors test renders a histogram; histogram theming is inferred from the shared bar renderer.
forced-colors is emulated in headless Chrome; native Windows High Contrast (Edge) has not been verified on a Windows host.

title: Live and streaming data
outcomeGuarantees: append(rows, { keep }) shows new rows and evicts old ones without losing the reader's place.
A Pause/Resume control buffers rows while paused and applies them on resume, including through eviction.
update, append and zoom apply in call order; streaming does not speak to screen readers.

manualAt.protocolNote: Silence of live updates (A7) is checked through live-region attributes only, not with a running screen reader.

ownedGaps.reason: acceptance/matrix.json and CHART_TYPES in acceptance/check.mjs have no histogram column, so histogram evidence is cited by test file only and has no matrix cell rollup.
Silence of live updates (A7) is checked through live-region attributes only, not with a running screen reader.
